Headline: #126 Jackson Temporary Reroute near Jackson/Hoyne
ShortDescription: #126 Jackson buses temporarily rerouted, due to police activity near Jackson/Hoyne.

FullDescription.#cdata-section:
#126 Jackson buses temporarily rerouted, due to police activity near Jackson/Hoyne.

Eastbound buses will operate via Jackson, Western, and Harrison then over their regular route.

Westbound buses will operate via Jackson, Damen, Van Buren, Western and Jackson then over their regular route.

Allow extra travel time.

Headline: Forest Park-bound Blue Line Service Delayed at Clark/Lake
ShortDescription: Forest Park-bound Blue Line trains are standing at Clark/Lake due to an      unauthorized person on the tracks. Crews working to restore service.

FullDescription.#cdata-section:
Forest Park-bound Blue Line trains are standing at Clark/Lake due to an unauthorized person on the tracks.

Consider other service alternatives that may serve your trip, such as nearby bus routes or using buses to other rail lines.

Personnel are working to restore service. Allow extra travel time.
